answer: One workable design: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because inlet only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. Concretely, thread is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any voyage approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
